annotations.description: agent_sessions_metrics_section_success_ratio is below 1 for this section, or agent_history_exporter_collection_errors_total increased for its collector in the last 30 minutes. Sections are isolated: the others keep updating while this one fails. Read the indexer logs for the section's error. loop_checkout means an observed v3 root has an allowlisted Git origin but its checkout is absent from git.repos; the hourly collector summary names unconfigured_allowlisted_checkout. loop_checkout_observation means the bounded observation is partial, not evidence that every checkout is configured. These two sections use the latest hourly agent-history-collect observation over two hours; the collector must have OTLP metrics enabled through its existing telemetry environment.
annotations.summary: The {{ $labels.section }} metric collector section is failing

model.expr: max by (section) ((min by (section) (agent_sessions_metrics_section_success_ratio{job="agent-history-index"}) < bool 1) == 1 or label_replace((sum by (collector) (increase(agent_history_exporter_collection_errors_total{job="agent-history-index"}[30m])) > bool 0) == 1, "section", "$1", "collector", "(.*)") or label_replace((max(last_over_time(agent_history_loop_checkout_unconfigured{job="agent-history-collect"}[2h])) > bool 0) == 1, "section", "loop_checkout", "", ".*") or label_replace((min(last_over_time(agent_history_loop_checkout_observation_complete_ratio{job="agent-history-collect"}[2h])) < bool 1) == 1, "section", "loop_checkout_observation", "", ".*"))
